item.title: Somehow, Fatal Fury is getting new Street Fighter costumes before Street Fighter 6 itself
item.description: <p>Although <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> had a very strong launch and continues to be the biggest fighting game around, Capcom's post-launch support can be considered sporadic at best.</p> <p>Street Fighter 6 players are continuing to wait for the next big content drop as they have been for almost five months, and now there's new Street Fighter costumes coming... but for a completely different game.</p>

item.title: Powerplex gameplay trailer revealed for Invincible Vs
item.description: <p>Powerplex has been revealed as the 14th character for Invincible Vs. His gameplay trailer debuted near the beginning of the IGN Fan Fest event.</p> <p>Though he's not aligned with the Viltrumites, Powerplex is considered to be an antagonist within Invincible. This is a character that is fixated on getting revenge against Invincible due to the deaths of certain family members.</p>

item.title: New Mortal Kombat 2 move trailer provides sneak peek at some of its epic fight scenes
item.description: <p>During the IGN Fan Fest, a new trailer for the Mortal Kombat 2 movie was dropped. As was previously alluded to, Johnny Cage, played by Karl Urban, is the main character of the film.</p> <p>The trailer starts out by showing a seemingly disgruntled Johnny Cage. In this timeline, Johnny Cage has become a washed up actor that hardly anyone cares about.</p>

item.title: New behind-the-scenes Alex video shows off mocap process for wrestling star Kenny Omega and bringing in some of his own moves
item.description: <p>IGN's Fan Fest 2026 has offered up quite a bit for fighting game fans already between the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/feb/25/mk2-movie-trailer-epic-fights/">new Mortal Kombat 2</a> trailer and <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/feb/25/powerplex-gameplay-trailer-invincible-vs/">Powerplex's reveal for Invincible VS</a>, but that's not all.</p> <p>They also brought on <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2018/may/27/new-japan-pro-wrestling-superstar-kenny-omega-star

item.title: One of Alex's four level 3 Super animations revealed for Street Fighter 6, and the dude keeps going after Ryu taps out
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> introduced characters having not only three Super Arts at their disposal but also the more powerful Critical Art at low health, and the next DLC character is taking things to another level in that area.</p> <p>Alex is going to have a total of four different level 3 Super animations in Street Fighter 6, and we just got to see a new one.</p>

item.title: Insomniac shows off full look at Spider-Man's special costume in Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls based on their Spider-Man 2 design
item.description: <p>It only took like eight months, but <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/feb/12/wolverine-announced-marvel-tokon/">Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls finally revealed more characters and its release date</a> recently as well as the different versions of the game available.</p> <p>Now, we can get a closer look at one of the bonus costumes that will be available in <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/marvel-tokon/">Marvel Tokon</a>, however, it's not coming from Arc System Works.</p>

item.title: Some of Warner Bros. Games' 'biggest franchises' to return starting next year, Netflix backs out of bidding war with Paramount
item.description: <p>Things have been very interesting in the world of Warner Bros. for a number of months now, and that doesn't seem to be slowing down any time soon.</p> <p>Warner Bros. Discovery held their latest earning conference call today where they talked a bit about what's in their future for gaming, and then came a big update on the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/05/mortal-kombat-netflix-acquisition/">bidding tug of war for the corporation between Netflix and Paramount</a>.</p>
